positions.title: Medical Biller/ Computer Technician
positions.description:
•	Provide IT Customer Service for Medical professionals and their offices
•	Help and maintain servers and run backups 
•	Contact and bill several insurance companies
•	Register, post, and bill medical claims
•	Follow HIPAA regulations
•	Maintain database of patient records and visits

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
Set up and configure computers, laptops, printers, projectors, cameras and any other components used with computers.
Diagnosis and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, projectors, cameras and any other components used with computers. 
Install and configure various software programs. 
Organized and managed role out of new computer labs
